In detail

The centre — Markthal, Blaak, the Lijnbaan, and the Witte de Withstraat and Stadhuisplein nightlife — and where visitors stay. Rotterdam runs a Veiligheidsindex as part of its Wijkprofiel, built from crime and nuisance figures together with a survey of around 30,000 residents between March and October 2025. Citywide it fell from 110 in 2022 to 104 in 2026, with the perception of safety dropping faster than the recorded figures. Centrum is the area the 2026 profile singles out: its safety score fell sharply, the steepest drop in the city, despite targeted municipal intervention. The college named youth, drug crime and violent offences as the standing priorities. Busy and workable by day; the bar streets at closing time are what is being measured.

Is Rotterdam Centrum safe?

Wandroz currently rates Rotterdam Centrum in Rotterdam as relatively safer than most other neighbourhoods in Rotterdam during the day and roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Rotterdam at night. Is Rotterdam Centrum safe at night?

At night, Rotterdam Centrum is rated as roughly average compared to other neighbourhoods in Rotterdam. If you're unsure, it's worth checking recent local reviews for your specific street or block, since a neighbourhood-wide rating can't capture block-by-block variation.
